<!-- Thanks for contributing! -->

**Furniture type:** <!-- Name, e.g. "Shoe cabinet with 2 flaps" -->

- [ ] The file is located at `objekte/<name>.json`, `"id"` is `"community.<name>"`
- [ ] `author` and a free `license` (`CC0-1.0`, `CC-BY-4.0` or `CC-BY-SA-4.0`) are set
- [ ] Checked in the homemgmt-ng editor: preview and compartments are correct
- [ ] For a change: `version` increased
- [ ] For a 3D model: `.glb` in `modelle/`, own rights to the model or a free license
